relationships.subject: Cannabigerol
relationships.evidence_quote: Using the von Frey test, we found that CBG-attenuated mechanical hypersensitivity evoked by cisplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy in both male and female mice.

relationships.subject: SB705498
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that the TRPV1 antagonist, SB705498 (20 mg/kg, i.p.) was unable to prevent CBG actions.

key_findings: CBG attenuated cisplatin-induced mechanical hypersensitivity in male and female mice but not formalin or tail-flick nociception.
CBG effect involved alpha2-adrenergic, CB1 and CB2 receptors but not TRPV1.
